generations.rawResponse:
ASSIST
Assuming each edge has weight 0 or 1, use 0-1 BFS: replace the FIFO queue with a deque, and maintain a distance for each vertex. Relax an edge only if it improves the neighbor’s distance; push a 0-weight neighbor to the front and a 1-weight neighbor to the back. A vertex may be improved after first discovery, so don’t mark it permanently visited on enqueue. With an adjacency list, it runs in O(V + E) time and O(V) space; for 10,000 vertices and 50,000 edges, that’s O(60,000) traversal work. If the weights are all zero, ordinary BFS still works, since every path has total weight zero.
